text:
Marta (CS Ops): quick sync — Constellation dedicated bring-up. They want sustained 500 RPS and burst to 800 for sales demos. Need quota + autoscale plan before we run loadtests.

Ava (CSM): customer confirmed ramp: ~2M tokens/day after week 1. Renewal in ~11 months; finance wants usage reports. SLA requested 99.9%.

Jon (Platform Eng): for their model (long-context, 8k) rough capacity: 1 A100 ~75 rps. To hit 500 sustained we should provision 7-8 GPUs. Suggest autoscale: min=6, target-buffer=20%, max=12, scale_step=2, cooldown=90s.

Ravi (SRE): agree with min 6. For loadtest we should include KV cache priming and prefix caching. Plan dry-run tonight 23:00 UTC? also enable fallback route to hosted-small-1.

Ava (CSM): I asked Constellation for a midnight window. They approved 23:00-00:30 UTC. They also gave a representative prompt set — pasting sizes below.

Ava (CSM): ```
seq_len_distribution: 60% <=1024, 30% 1025-4096, 10% >4096
avg_tokens_per_request: 120
peak_concurrent_users: 120
```

Jon (Platform Eng): perfect. I'll tune kernel selection for >4k tails and enable continuous batching with max_batch=64 for test.

Ravi (SRE): test watchlist: p50/p95/p99 latency, token/sec throughput, GPU mem spill, error_rate. If p99 > 2s, trigger autoscale threshold earlier.

Marta (CS Ops): we need to capture risk: if autoscaling misbehaves or we don't hit throughput, customer has renewal leverage. Marking renewal-risk: medium->high until post-bakeoff.

Ava (CSM): noted. Also asked for warmup budget: requesting 50k tokens/day for 3 days for priming. Can we grant as one-off?

Jon (Platform Eng): one-time quota bump approved by finance for first 30 days: temporary cap -> 10 reserved GPUs. Will log usage and report back.

Marta (CS Ops): I'll spin up a short runbook checklist: pre-warm steps, KV priming script, cache headers, rollback plan, who-on-call. Link when ready.

OpsBot: runbook created: /runbooks/constellation-onboard v1 — owners @Marta (CS Ops), @Jon (Platform Eng), @Ravi (SRE).

DeployBot: loadtest job lt-1923 queued for 2026-03-25T23:00:00Z (window 90m).

Ava (CSM): I'll confirm final headcount and share the eval prompt set for quality gating. Also logging that sales demo on day 4 needs burst to 800 RPS for 10m windows.

Ravi (SRE): during the run we'll also run a brief chaos test (node drain simulation) to validate fallback to hosted and autoscale rebuild. Keep rollback plan ready.

Marta (CS Ops): excellent. Action items: Jon -> deploy autoscale policy + priming scripts; Ravi -> runbook + monitoring alerts; Ava -> confirm customer test window + send prompt set; Marta -> create renewal-risk note in CRM and link runbook.

Jon (Platform Eng): will do. Pushing autoscale config to staging now, will share config snippet.

DeployBot: loadtest started lt-1923 at 2026-03-25T23:00:05Z (this is a simulated message queued for the window).

Ava (CSM): thanks team — will update Constellation once we have post-test metrics. :thumbsup:
